objective: fixed monthly intersection of model-score Top2 and 60-session momentum Top2

rule.signal: first trading session of each calendar month at close
rule.score: rank cached V1 ensemble score descending across finite-score names; select Top2
rule.momentum: rank adjusted close(T)/adjusted close(T-60 sessions)-1 descending; select Top2
rule.selection: hold only names in both independently ranked Top2 lists; 0/1/2 names allowed
rule.allocation: target 50% of current pre-trade NAV per selected name; unused target allocation remains cash
rule.execution: T+1 open; 100-share lots, 1% previous signal-day amount capacity, limit locks, 3bp slippage and fees
